definitions: The action of demolishing a building or structure.
The action of reducing the price of something, especially at an auction.
The action of causing someone or something to fall to the ground.
The action of consuming an alcoholic drink quickly.
examples: They are knocking down the old factory.
The auctioneer was knocking down items quickly.
He was knocking down pins at the bowling alley.
She was knocking down pints at the pub.
